description: Synthetic only. Each query is a contract clause; expected is the template chunk it should find.

templates.title: Royalties
templates.text: The Producer shall pay the Artist a royalty of not less than fifteen per cent of the gross receipts from the sale, streaming and licensing of the recordings.

templates.title: Payment and statements
templates.text: Royalties shall be paid within thirty days after the end of each calendar quarter, together with a statement showing how the amount was calculated.

templates.title: Audit
templates.text: The Artist may, on reasonable written notice, inspect and audit the Producer's books and records relating to the recordings once in every year.

templates.title: Term
templates.text: This Agreement shall continue for a period of two years from the date of signing and may be renewed only by written agreement of both parties.

templates.title: Exclusivity
templates.text: During the term the Artist shall not record the same works for any other producer, and this restriction ends when the Agreement ends.

templates.title: Termination
templates.text: Either party may terminate this Agreement by giving sixty days' written notice if the other party fails to remedy a material breach.

templates.title: Ownership
templates.text: Copyright in the master recordings shall be owned by the Producer for the term, after which all rights revert to the Artist.

templates.title: Assignment
templates.text: The Assignor assigns to the Assignee the copyright in the works listed in the Schedule, for the territory and period stated in the Schedule.

templates.title: Commission
templates.text: The Manager shall receive a commission of twenty per cent of the Artist's gross earnings from activities in the entertainment industry during the term.

templates.title: Recoupment
templates.text: Advances are recoupable only from the Artist's royalties and shall never be repayable by the Artist out of other income.

templates.title: Governing law
templates.text: This Agreement is governed by the laws of Kenya and the courts of Kenya have jurisdiction.

templates.title: Notices
templates.text: Any notice under this Agreement shall be in writing and delivered by hand or email to the addresses set out above.

queries.text: The Label will pay the Artist ten percent of net receipts from sales and streams after deducting all costs.
Artist royalty: 12% of what the Company actually receives from digital platforms.
Royalty payments will be made once a year, at the Company's discretion, without statements.
The Artist has no right to examine the Company's accounts.
This contract lasts for seven years and the Company alone may extend it.
The Artist may not work with any other label for two years after this agreement ends.
Only the Company may end this agreement, at any time and without notice.
The Company owns the master recordings forever, throughout the universe.
Any advance not recovered from royalties must be paid back by the Artist personally.
I hereby transfer all my copyright in every song I write, worldwide and forever.
The Manager takes thirty per cent of everything the Artist earns, including after the term.
This agreement is subject to the laws of England and only English courts may hear disputes.
Notices are valid only if sent by registered post to the Company's head office.
